messages:
maya: Heads-up: I hit a bundler + edge runtime failure with a symlinked workspace package. Minimal repro attached.

maya: Setup: monorepo with `apps/web` and `packages/ui-kit` (pnpm workspace / npm link). ui-kit is ESM (`type": "module") and has exports that include an `import` and a `default` CJS fallback.

maya: App does `import { Button } from 'ui-kit'` and we build for edge (vite + our edge plugin). Start the edge dev server and get: `TypeError: require is not defined`.

maya: Stack points to `.cache/vite/deps/vendor-ui-kit.js` which contains a CJS wrapper injected by the bundler for the linked package.

simon: Interesting. Does published ui-kit (installed from registry) behave the same?

maya: No, only happens when ui-kit is a symlinked local package. Published package resolves to ESM entry and works.

alex: Likely resolver heuristics choose the `default` export path for file: or symlinked dependency. Bundlers sometimes prefer CJS for dedupe/interop. Edge runtime has no `require`, so CJS wrapper breaks.

maya: package.json for ui-kit (excerpt):
```
{
  "name": "ui-kit",
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
      "default": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
    }
  }
}
```

tyler: Can you reproduce on rollup/webpack/vite or just vite?

maya: Repros on vite, rollup, and webpack (all three end up bundling the cjs fallback when the package is a workspace symlink).

simon: Workaround: remove the cjs fallback from exports for workspace packages or force bundler mainFields to prefer `module`/`imports`. Did you try overriding resolve behavior?

maya: I tried `resolve.mainFields = ['module','main']` in webpack and `optimizeDeps.esbuildOptions.mainFields` in vite, but the symlinked dep still resolved to CJS. The resolver path for linked packages appears to follow different heuristics.

alex: Short-term unblock: publish a private snapshot package or change package exports to only expose the ESM entry. Not great long term.

simon: Long-term: update our edge bundling plugin to detect symlinked/workspace packages and prefer `exports.import` unconditionally. Also add a warning if a linked package has a CJS fallback.

maya: I put up a tiny repro archive here: https://internal.redwood/repros/monorepo-symlink-edge-2957654321.tar.gz and started a draft PR with a resolve plugin sketch.

ci-bot: build: CI job #4847 started for branch maya/edge-symlink-repro.

tyler: For CI, add a matrix: bundlers [vite, rollup, webpack] x package-source [symlink, published]. That will catch regressions.

alex: Also add a docs blurb in the monorepo onboarding: "avoid CJS fallback entries for workspace packages when targeting edge runtimes".

maya: Agree. I'll open PR with tests for all three bundlers and the docs note. Will ping when ready.

simon: Thanks! Leaving a reaction.

maya: Cheers, thanks for the quick triage.
